I don't want any of that Kel Dor filth to survive.|General Grievous|}} A '''battle droid commander''' was a member of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] served under the command of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] during the [[Battle of Dorin]]. When Grievous ordered the commander to escalate the attack, as an act of revenge against the native [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dors]] of [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] for staying loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Commander sent [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] to hunt down the survivors of the battle. However, the counter-attack of the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], led by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], forced the Separatists to retreat from the planet. ==Biography== {{Quote|The commando droids will hunt down any survivors.''"
"''Very good.|The Commander and Grievous|}} During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] served in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' the Commander participated in the [[battle of Dorin]], an attack launched by Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The battle [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was deployed on the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], where the droid's troops started to overwhelm the resisting forces of the native [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dors]].{{TCWA|Starfighter}} The Commander then led the attack on the civilian population of Dorin, causing devastating damage and killing many Kel Dors. The droid was soon contacted by Grievous, who was overseeing the battle from his [[Grievous's Separatist frigate|command ship]] over the planet, and ordered the droid to press the attack to punish the inhabitans of the planet for staying loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In response, the Commander sent several [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] to search and [[Death/Legends|kill]] any survivors. However, Grievous soon learned that a Republic task force was sent to aid the Kel Dors, and he recalled his troops from the surface. Although the General had his [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] prepared to repel the Republic's attack, the Republic task force was ultimately successful in destroying many of Grievous' [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and routing the rest of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], as well as Grievous himself, out from Dorin.{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}} ==Characteristics== {{Quote|Roger, roger.|The Commander|}} A field commander during the battle of Dorin, the battle droid followed the orders of General Grievous in a dutiful manner, laying waste to the Dorin civilian population. When Grievous made it clear he wanted all of the Kel Dors death, the Commander agreed, and showed no remorse for sending commando droids to hunt down the people who had survived from the battle. ==Behind the scenes== This battle droid commander only appeared in [http://www.starwars.com/theclonewars/news20091103fd/index.html a script] presented at the [[2009]] [[Star Wars]] Fan Days III convention, which served as a prelude to "[[Landing at Point Rain]]," the fifth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. In the script, the droid received a minor, once-speaking role. Since the script does not provide any characteristic information about the Commander, no assumptions can be made of the droid's explicit model or its [[Gender/Legends|gender programming]]. ==Sources== *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091103fd/index.html|text=Fan Days Script: A Prelude to "Point Rain"}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Droide de combate comandante (Dorin) }} [[Category:Battle droids]] [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Separatist officers]]
